written.headline: Nvidia sales team introduced Alibaba to Alice Huang in 2022
written.summary: Nvidia's sales team introduced Chinese tech giant Alibaba to Alice Huang on two occasions in 2022. The introductions helped Huang establish Alibaba as a customer for her chip-rental business, which later faced U.S. export control inquiries.

written.headline: AI-assisted hackers breach Delhi-NCR NBFCs and divert Rs 65 cr
written.summary: Hackers diverted over Rs 65 crore in approved loans from 12 non-banking financial companies across Delhi-NCR over three months using malware and suspected AI. Senior Delhi Police officers stated that these cases form part of over 150 FIRs filed by NBFCs nationwide.

written.headline: 92% of Indian organisations hit by AI agent security incidents, survey shows
written.summary: A survey by ServiceNow found that 92 percent of Indian organisations experienced an AI agent security incident in the past year, but only 36 percent contained the incident within 24 hours. The report highlights governance gaps, with only 19 percent having a single named individual accountable for agentic AI security.

written.headline: Botsync raises $11 million to expand industrial automation
written.summary: Singapore-headquartered Botsync has raised $11 million in a funding round led by IvyCap Ventures to expand its industrial automation operations. The company builds autonomous mobile robots and software for factory and distribution-centre operations.
